book.name: 1 Timoteo
book.title: Enyaarubha yo okutaanga ya Pauro ku Timoteo

content: Obhuswaagyo kubhiikirirya
Otabhiiyogya abhakaruka, nawe obhatoongere kyeego okutoongera wuuso weenyu. Abhamura obhatoongere kyeego abhahiiri bhaazo,
abhakiikuru kyeego nyoko weenyu, na abhaakya obhakorere kwe ekoro nzomu kyeego abhasubhaati bheenyu.
Obhasuuke abhatuumba bhano bhatana wo okubhasakirya.

Nawe, eraabhe omutuumba wowoosi ana abhaana kasi abhazukuru, bhayo bheege okusakirya abhahiiri bhaabhu. Hano bhakukora ego, niho bharariha abhiibhuri bhaabhu amazomu gano bhabhakoreeri. Ego niigo Taatabhugya akweenda.
Omutuumba wuno atana muutu wo okumusakirya, wuyo aramwiisiga Taatabhugya, aramuseengera no okumusabha Taatabhugya amusakirye obhutiku no omwiisi.
Nawe omutuumba wuno akuseega enaamba ye ekyaaro, wuyo akuuri yiingabha ararorekana muhoru.
Amangʼana gayo, obhabhuurire abhiikirirya, okubha bhataaza kubha na amasoro.
Nawe omuutu wowoosi wuno atakusakirya abhaatu bhaaye, kiindi bha munyuumba yaaye, wuyo arabha atigiri obhwiikirirya, kweeki abheeri mubhiihu kukira omuutu wuno atari mwiikirirya.
Omutuumba ariikiriribhwa okubharwa mubhatuumba, eraabhe ahikirye emyaaka kweemera miroongo esaasabha (60), kweeki yaari mukari wo omusubhe wumwe.

Abhe ano omukumo muzomu kumahokya gaaye. Abhe areriri abhaana bhaaye bhuzomu, abhe araginihya abhagini, abhe arabhiisaabhya abhahoreeru amaguru gaabhu, abhe arabhasakirya bhano bhakunyaakibhwa, kweeki abhe ariiruusya na yiibhanwiiri okukora amahokya amazomu.
Nawe, abhakari abhatuumba, otabhaha omweeya kusikira mubhubharwa, kwo okubha enaamba yo omubhiri erabhatama kukira okwiiruusya ku Krisito, hayo bhareenda okukweerwa.
Kwo okukora ego, bharabha bhatiniirwe ekiina, kwo okubha bhatigiri obhurage bhwaabhu ku Krisito bhwo okusaaga bhakyaari kukweerwa.

Abhatuumba kya bhayo, bhanariri eteemo yo obhutobhu, bharageendageenda muziinyuumba zya abhaatu. Kweeki, bharabha abhagwaatania no okwiisikirya mumangʼana ga abhaandi, eno bharabhuga amangʼana gano gatakweenderwa.
Bhoono, enye ndeenda abhatuumba abhasubhaati, bhabhe bharakweerwa, bhiibhure abhaana no okutuga eziinyuumba zyaabhu, okubha abhabhisa bheetu bhatige okutugaamba bhubhi.
Rora kubha abhatuumba abhasubhaati abhaandi bhamariri okubhura no okumutuniirira Seetaani.

Kyo omukari omwiikirirya ana abhatuumba mubhahiiri bhaaye, abhasakirye. Akore ego, okubha ekanisa etigwe kutamirwa, niho ekanisa erabha no omweeya gwo okusakirya abhatuumba abhaandi bhano bhatana obhusakirya.
Abhakaruka bhe ekanisa bhano bhakwiimeererera ekanisa bhuzomu, bhasuukwe no okukorerwa amazomu,
kiindi bhano bhakwiiruusya okurwaaza no okweegya engʼana ya Taatabhugya.
Niragaamba ego, kwo okubha ekaamirwe mu Makaamo Amahoreeru, “Engʼoombe hano ekuhuura engano, otayibhoha omunwa.”
Kweeki ekaamirwe, “Omuhokya wuyo woosi areenderwa ahaabhwe amariho gaaye.”
Otiikirirya amasemo iguru yo omukaruka we ekanisa, otana obhumenyeekererya bhwa abhaatu bhabhiri kasi bhatatu.
Nawe abhakaruka bhe ekanisa bhano bhakugeenderera okukora amabhi, obharekye embere wa bhoosi, okubha abhaandi bhayo bhoobhohe.
Obhurekya ku Timoteo
Nirakuswaagya embere wa Taatabhugya, ne embere ya Krisito Yeesu na bhamaraika abhasorwa kubha, ogwaatirire gayo, otatina ekiina kwa bhwaangu kasi okuseega orubhaara rumwe.

Otiikirirya kwa bhwaangu kumutuurira omuutu amabhoko akore emirimo gyo Omukuru, kwo okubha orimutuurira omuutu omubhi amabhoko, awe orabha wiisaangirye mubhubhi bhwaaye. Awe wiiriihe, okubha osaage kubha omuheene.
Kweemera bhoono, awe otanywa amaanzi ageene, nawe obhe oranywa na amaanzi go omuzabibu
masuuhu kwiiguru yo obhurweeri bhwaazo bhwe enda na amarweeri agaandi gano gakukunyaakya.
Abhaatu abhaandi, ebhibhi bhyaabhu bhirarorekana kubhweero, naabhe bhakyaari kutinirwa ekiina. Nawe abhaatu abhaandi, ebhibhi bhyaabhu bhiibhisiri, bhirarorekana ibhaga riindi.
Egoego, amahokya amazomu gararorekana kubhweero. Na garya giibhisiri, garabha kubhweero.

footnotes.text: Bhasuukwe no okukorerwa amazomu ku Kiyunaani ni bhasuukwe maanga abhiri.
Amaanzi go omuzabibu. Rora amangʼana gano mu Bhugaruri bhwa Amangʼana Amakongʼu.
